nodes.label: Tailwind in Plugins Guide
nodes.rationale: Documents how plugins can use Tailwind CSS with the reference Vite config, including the preset, build hook, traps to avoid (preflight, layers, prefix collisions), and the decision not to migrate base plugins.

nodes.label: Tailwind Preset for Plugins
nodes.rationale: Granular imports (no preflight, no layers), per-plugin prefix, dark/compact/touch variants, @theme inline mapping to kernel tokens, --spacing as half of --lm-space, tap utilities.

nodes.label: Tailwind Build Hook
nodes.rationale: Compiles style.css with @tailwindcss/postcss in closeBundle hook. Virtual from path inside node_modules for resolution. Opt-in per plugin via pluginConfig({ tailwind: true }).
